title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
content:
arXiv:2610.12598v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Exper
author: Yiran Wu, Andrew Zhao, Yurui Chang, Qingyun Wu, Xuan Feng
summary_zh: 论文提出行为自奖励（BSR）方法，用于解决软件工程智能体在可验证奖励强化学习中只有二元奖励的问题：二元奖励无法区分调试质量相差很大的轨迹。BSR不需要单独训练奖励模型，而是让当前策略自己比较同一任务、同一验证结果下各条轨迹的可观察调试行为，把成对偏好汇总成任务内评分，再转成有上界的辅助奖励。这项研究对理解编程智能体（如Claude Code这类SWE Agent）的训练方式有参考价值，但内容偏学术，对日常使用没有直接帮助。

title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
content:
arXiv:2610.12596v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that pa
author: Scott C. Lowe, Sander W. Keemink
summary_zh: SpireBench让20个大语言模型在最高难度下完整游玩卡牌构筑游戏《杀戮尖塔》，用来评测智能体模型在长周期任务中的策略推理能力。结果显示，前沿模型能胜过启发式基线，达到普通人类玩家的平均水平，但仍远不如专家。而且对局越长差距越大，最强的模型在第一幕的胜率与专家相当，之后就逐渐落后。这说明长任务智能体的规划能力仍有明显短板，对理解编程智能体在长任务中的局限有参考价值。

title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
content:
arXiv:2610.12655v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification valu
author: Jiatan Huang, Zheyuan Zhang, Ziming Li, Tianyi Ma, Mingchen Li, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang
summary_zh: 论文提出CLEAT框架，把“澄清价值控制器”和任务策略放在一起协同训练，让LLM智能体在用户没说清目标和约束时，能判断什么时候值得追问。框架用“残余查询价值”衡量一次澄清对任务效用的实际提升，以便在交互中更好地对齐用户意图。这对理解AI编程助手何时该向用户提问、何时该直接执行有参考价值。

title: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
summary_zh: 文章介绍NVIDIA如何微调Nemotron模型家族，使其在国际信息学奥林匹克（IOI）和国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）中都达到金牌水平。正文内容为空，只能根据标题判断，推测主要讲推理和代码能力的训练方法。文章与LLM模型能力相关，但和Claude Code或AI编程工具的实际使用关系不大。
